title: Quick Sketch of a Resting Dog
content: Smooth and I wait at a picnic table outside theCulinary Institute's Egg Caféwhile the rest of my gang goes in and gets supper.Here he is in watercolor, colored pencils, fountain pen and white gel pen.I sometimes go straight to watercolor+  because it’s the fastest technique, and you need FAST when you’re sketching live animals.View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)
